verdict.rationale: Atlas documents online formation of Delaware C corps and LLCs within two business days. It also covers founder equity issuance, EIN acquisition and 83(b) filing, and provides incorporation documents built on Cooley templates in the Atlas Dashboard. Several founders confirm hands-on that they incorporated through it successfully. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that bylaws and initial board consents are among the generated documents (only implied by 'incorporation documents' and 'Cooley templates'), and independent confirmation that board approvals are executed online end-to-end.
